Industrial provides on equipment it manufactures, the basis on which a claim from an authorised service partner is adjudicated, and the amounts payable. It applies to every claim submitted through the service claim system.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 1. Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. A Bulletin that has been superseded has no effect, whether or not it remains published. Where the Bulletin document and the service system applicability index disagree, the Bulletin document governs; the index is maintained for reporting and is informational only.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. Coverage\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1  Standard coverage period\\r\\n  \\r\\nUnless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3  Assets with no commissioning record\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. The claim is to be held and the commissioning certificate requested from the installing partner. The date of despatch or the date of installation must not be substituted for the date of commissioning.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Amounts payable\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1  Labour\\r\\n  \\r\\nLabour is payable at the flat-rate allowance published for the operation code in the current Flat Rate Labour schedule, or at the hours actually claimed, whichever is the lesser. The rate applied is the regional labour rate in force on the date of repair.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2  Parts\\r\\n  \\r\\nParts are payable at the published list price for the region, for the part actually fitted. Where a part has been superseded, the price of the superseding part applies.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3  Handling\\r\\n  \\r\\nA handling uplift on parts is payable only where the partner\\u0027s Service Partner Agreement expressly grants one, at the percentage stated in that agreement.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Exclusions\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.1  Exclusion - misuse and overload\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from operation outside the published duty envelope, including sustained overload, is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.2  Exclusion - fluid contamination\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from hydraulic fluid contamination above ISO 4406 class 18/16/13 is excluded, save where a Technical Service Bulletin provides otherwise.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.3  Exclusion - unauthorised modification\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from modification not authorised in writing by Contoso Industrial is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.4  Exclusion - consumables\\r\\n  \\r\\nFilters, fluids, belts, seals and other consumables are excluded when replaced as scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance is not claimable under warranty and has no warranty operation code, so a consumable claimed under a warranty repair operation code is treated as a corrective repair and is covered, unless an inspection report records the replacement as routine.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 6. Repair warranty\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6.1  Repair warranty\\r\\n  \\r\\nA component replaced under warranty carries a further ninety (90) days of coverage from the date the repair was completed. A claim arising within that period is adjudicated under this clause and carries funding code RW, whether or not the underlying asset remains within its coverage period.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 7. Goodwill and authority\\r\\n\\r\\n### 7.1  Goodwill authority\\r\\n  \\r\\nAn amount payable outside coverage may be authorised as goodwill only by a person holding the tier of authority set out in the Goodwill and Authority Matrix for that amount, and only where the authority is recorded in the claim system. Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. A Bulletin that has been superseded has no effect, whether or not it remains published. Where the Bulletin document and the service system applicability index disagree, the Bulletin document governs; the index is maintained for reporting and is informational only.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. Coverage\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1  Standard coverage period\\r\\n  \\r\\nUnless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3  Assets with no commissioning record\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. The claim is to be held and the commissioning certificate requested from the installing partner. The date of despatch or the date of installation must not be substituted for the date of commissioning.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Amounts payable\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1  Labour\\r\\n  \\r\\nLabour is payable at the flat-rate allowance published for the operation code in the current Flat Rate Labour schedule, or at the hours actually claimed, whichever is the lesser. The rate applied is the regional labour rate in force on the date of repair.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2  Parts\\r\\n  \\r\\nParts are payable at the published list price for the region, for the part actually fitted. Where a part has been superseded, the price of the superseding part applies.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3  Handling\\r\\n  \\r\\nA handling uplift on parts is payable only where the partner\\u0027s Service Partner Agreement expressly grants one, at the percentage stated in that agreement.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Exclusions\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.1  Exclusion - misuse and overload\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from operation outside the published duty envelope, including sustained overload, is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.2  Exclusion - fluid contamination\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from hydraulic fluid contamination above ISO 4406 class 18/16/13 is excluded, save where a Technical Service Bulletin provides otherwise.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.3  Exclusion - unauthorised modification\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from modification not authorised in writing by Contoso Industrial is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.4  Exclusion - consumables\\r\\n  \\r\\nFilters, fluids, belts, seals and other consumables are excluded when replaced as scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance is not claimable under warranty and has no warranty operation code, so a consumable claimed under a warranty repair operation code is treated as a corrective repair and is covered, unless an inspection report records the replacement as routine.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 6. Repair warranty\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6.1  Repair warranty\\r\\n  \\r\\nA component replaced under warranty carries a further ninety (90) days of coverage from the date the repair was completed. A claim arising within that period is adjudicated under this clause and carries funding code RW, whether or not the underlying asset remains within its coverage period.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 7. Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. Coverage\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1  Standard coverage period\\r\\n  \\r\\nUnless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3  Assets with no commissioning record\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. UserQuery: Can you work up C-2026-04103 for me — coverage position and payable amount?

Response.Content: ## C-2026-04103 — work-up **Recommended coverage position: APPROVE under standard India warranty coverage.** **Payable: INR 19,150.00.** ### Coverage analysis - Claim **C-2026-04103** is for a seal-kit replacement on asset **CIE-2200-AC-00320**, repaired **22 April 2026**. The partner claimed **3.0 labour hours** and part **P-22120**. - The asset is installed in **Pune, India** and was commissioned on **2 May 2025**. The repair therefore occurred about 11 months and 20 days after commissioning. - Under **ADD-IN-2.1**, India coverage is **18 months from commissioning or 5,000 running hours, whichever occurs first**. - The latest reading at or before repair was **2,750 hours** on 2 April 2026. The asset was therefore inside both the time and hours limits. - The job record confirms that **P-22120 was actually fitted**, with **3.0 hours** recorded against the corrective warranty operation `SEAL-KIT-RR`. - Although the claim-system bulletin index flags **TSB-P-0115**, the authoritative bulletin is **EMEA-only** and concerns the **drive train**, not seals. It does not apply to this India seal repair. Under policy clause 1.4, the bulletin document governs over the informational index. - No repair-warranty basis is needed: there is no prior matching component claim, and the asset remains within ordinary coverage. ### Payable calculation | Element | Calculation | Payable | |---|---:|---:| | Part | P-22120, actual fitted/current part, India list price | INR 14,800.00 | | Labour | Lesser of 3.0 hours claimed and 3.0-hour flat rate × INR 1,450/hour | INR 4,350.00 | | Parts handling uplift | 0% under the partner record | INR 0.00 | | **Total** | 14,800 + 4,350 | **INR 19,150.00** | The part record gives a current India price of **INR 14,800**, with no supersession. The FY26 flat-rate schedule allows **3.0 hours** for `SEAL-KIT-RR`, and the India labour rate effective from 1 April 2026 is **INR 1,450/hour**. Fabrikam Service Partners has **no parts-handling uplift**. ### Recommended disposition - **Decision:** Approve - **Funding basis:** Standard warranty — **ADD-IN-2.1**, read with **POL-WAR-4.2 clauses 1.4, 4.1, 4.2 and 4.3** - **Payable:** **INR 19,150.00** - **Suggested note:** “Asset within India coverage at repair: commissioned 02-May-2025; 2,750 hours at latest pre-repair reading. Corrective seal-kit replacement confirmed; P-22120 fitted. Labour allowed 3.0 h at INR 1,450/h. TSB-P-0115 index hit disregarded because authoritative bulletin is EMEA-only and drive-train-specific.” I have **not posted the draft adjudication** to the claim system yet. ## Sources 1. `claim` Result from get_claim 2. `asset` Result from get_asset 3. `india-addendum` [ADD-IN-2.1 Regional Addendum — India v2.1]() 4. `hours` Result from get_running_hours 5. `history` Result from get_service_history 6. `tsb-index` Result from get_tsb_index 7. `tsb-0115` [TSB-P-0115 Extended coverage — 2200-series drive motor, EMEA only]() 8. `prior` Result from find_prior_claims 9. `part` Result from lookup_part 10. `flat-rate` [Flat Rate Labour Schedule — FY26]() 11. `labour-rate` [Regional Labour Rates — FY26]() 12. `dealer` Result from get_dealer
